Setup guide
I am using WooCommerce pages
Leave the setting above On. You do not need to do anything else; the Shop page and product pages become donation pages automatically.
My product page uses a custom design (Avada Layout, Elementor Pro template)
If the template has WooCommerce’s Add to cart element, it is converted to Donate automatically. Otherwise add this shortcode to the template once: [wdp_donation_button_panel] Copy
Avada: Layouts → product layout → Code Block → paste → Save.
I am building my own donation page
For a list: [wdp_donations] Copy (the “Donation List” widget in Elementor, the “Donation list” block in Gutenberg). For a single product: [wdp_donation_button_panel slug="urun-kisa-adi"] Copy
Open the form test page
